title: Material-ID draft
description: Flat colour per material class with no line art or shading, for a material mask draft.

body.subject: The FIRST image is a grey clay render of a 3D model.
body.action: Colour every surface of the FIRST image with ONE flat, unshaded colour per material class: {{classes}}. Keep every shape exactly where it is, same outline and scale.
body.camera: Keep the camera and outline of the FIRST image.
body.style: Flat colour regions with hard edges, no lines, no outlines, no gradients, no lighting, no shadows, no texture.
body.constraints: Each material class a single distinct flat colour; plain flat white background; no text.

classes.default: plate metal red, gold trim yellow, cloth green, leather blue, undersuit black
classes.description: the material classes and the flat colour each gets

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: number of colour regions against the parts recipe
